Looking for more than just a job?  
  Ready to build a career where no two days are the same?  
 At  Programmed Skilled Workforce , we're not just filling jobs-we're building careers, supporting local businesses and creating opportunities that change lives. 
 We're looking for an energetic, motivated and people-focused  Resourcing Specialist  to join our Coffs Harbour team. 
  No recruitment experience? No problem. If you've built great relationships in hospitality, retail, customer service, sales or another people-focused industry and you're ready for a career where you can genuinely grow, we'll teach you the rest.  
 Whether you're starting your career, looking for your next challenge or ready to step into a role with real progression, we'd love to hear from you. 
  This isn't your average recruitment role.  
 While you'll begin by helping connect great people with great employers, you'll also have the opportunity to develop into a true  360° Recruitment Specialist , learning every aspect of the business. 
 You'll gain experience in: 
 
 Recruiting and interviewing candidates 
 Building talent pools 
 Managing employee relationships 
 Visiting client sites 
 Developing new business opportunities 
 Building long-term client partnerships 
 Sales and business development 
 Workforce planning 
 Growing existing accounts 
 
 As your confidence grows, so will your opportunities. You'll be supported to build your skills across recruitment, account management and business development, giving you the foundations for a long-term career. 
  What we're looking for  
 We don't expect you to know everything. 
 We value  attitude, energy and a willingness to learn  over years of experience. 
 You'll be someone who: 
 
 Loves working with people 
 Builds genuine relationships 
 Has a positive, can-do attitude 
 Is organised and enjoys variety 
 Thrives in a fast-paced environment 
 Enjoys solving problems 
 Is motivated by achieving goals 
 Wants to build a rewarding career 
 
 Experience in recruitment, customer service, labour hire, sales, retail, hospitality or administration is highly regarded-but not essential. 
  What you'll receive  
 
 Full training and ongoing mentoring 
 Career progression into recruitment, account management and sales 
 Supportive regional leadership team invested in your success 
 A fun, energetic and collaborative culture 
 The opportunity to work with some of the region's leading employers 
 Recognition and reward programs 
 A role where your effort genuinely makes a difference to people's lives 
 

  Who we are  
 As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to. 
 At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. 
 We welcome and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply. 
   So it's over to you, if this opportunity is right for you apply today!    
  To learn more about Programmed, we encourage you to visit our website.   Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Marketing Specialist at Misty's Collectables
Help build one of Australia's fastest-growing trading card businesses.
Misty's Collectables is one of Queensland's largest trading card retailers, specialising in Pokémon, One Piece, and more. Between our retail stores, online business, live streaming, conventions, PSA submissions and growing wholesale brands, we're expanding quickly—and we're looking for an exceptional Marketing Specialist to grow with us.
This isn't a role where you'll simply schedule a few social media posts. We're looking for someone who is passionate about developing and delivering effective marketing campaigns, building strong customer engagement, and helping grow a brand that stands out in the market.
What you'll be doing (Responsibilities) 
•	Developing, coordinating and implementing marketing campaigns for new product launches, events and promotions.
•	Developing and implementing digital marketing strategies to increase brand awareness, customer engagement and sales.
•	Managing the company's presence across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, ensuring marketing activities are aligned across all digital channels.
•	Planning, coordinating and implementing promotional activities and marketing campaigns for tournaments, conventions, live streams and in-store events.
•	Producing and editing marketing materials, including photography and video content, to support marketing campaigns and promotional initiatives.
•	Preparing and coordinating email marketing campaigns and customer communications.
•	Collaborating with our streaming team to maximise the reach and effectiveness of promotional campaigns and live events.
•	Collaborating with the owners to develop and implement long-term marketing strategies and promotional initiatives.
•	Monitoring, evaluating and analysing the performance of marketing campaigns and recommending improvements to maximise marketing effectiveness.
•	Monitoring digital marketing trends and identifying opportunities to improve brand visibility, customer engagement and business growth.
What we're looking for (Skills and Experience) 
•	Experience in digital marketing and campaign management.
•	Experience developing and implementing marketing campaigns across digital channels.
•	Strong copywriting and communication skills.
•	Experience with Meta, TikTok and Google advertising platforms.
•	Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design and editing software.
•	Strong photography and video editing skills to develop marketing and promotional materials.
•	A creative and strategic thinker who enjoys developing innovative marketing initiatives.
•	Someone who can work independently, take ownership of projects and manage multiple priorities.
•	Experience analysing marketing performance and using insights to optimise campaign effectiveness is highly regarded.
•	A genuine passion for trading cards, gaming, collectibles or pop culture is a huge advantage (but not essential).
Why join Misty's?
•	Work in one of Australia's most exciting trading card businesses.
•	Be part of a passionate, fast-moving team.
•	Help shape the marketing direction of a rapidly growing company.
•	Every day is different—from product launches and live streams to conventions and community events.
•	Genuine opportunities to grow your role as the business expands.
Salary: $80,000–$90,000 per annum plus superannuation
If you're passionate about developing marketing strategies, delivering impactful campaigns and helping build one of Australia's leading trading card brands, we'd love to hear from you.
To apply, send us your resume, a short cover letter, and examples of marketing campaigns or projects you've worked on.

result.description:
Lead enterprise AI strategy, architecture, and delivery across transformative digital initiatives.   Your new company   Join a forward-thinking organisation undergoing a significant digital and data transformation journey. With a strong focus on innovation, emerging technologies, and data-driven decision-making, this organisation is investing in modern AI, analytics, and digital platforms to enhance business outcomes and create long-term value. You will be part of a collaborative environment where technology plays a critical role in shaping future capabilities across the enterprise.    Your new role     
 As the Technical Lead - AI, you will provide both strategic direction and hands-on leadership across enterprise AI, data, analytics, intelligent automation, and digital platform initiatives. Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams, you will drive the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and business-aligned solutions. 
 You will lead the development of enterprise AI and data platforms, define future-state architecture, establish trusted data foundations, and guide the implementation of modern integration and automation capabilities. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will facilitate technical workshops, influence technology roadmaps, and ensure delivery outcomes align with organisational objectives. 
 In addition, you will mentor development teams, promote engineering best practices, and provide governance across solution design, cybersecurity, Responsible AI, and enterprise architecture standards. 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Proven experience leading complex AI, data, digital transformation, or enterprise technology programs. 
 Strong hands-on expertise in software engineering, solution architecture, and cloud-based platform delivery. 
 Experience designing and implementing AI and data solutions leveraging technologies such as AWS, Snowflake, Cortex AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, and Agent-based solutions. 
 Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, semantic modelling, canonical data structures, API and integration architecture, governance, and security frameworks. 
 Ability to define technology strategy, future-state architecture, and scalable solution roadmaps. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and business decision-makers. 
 Experience mentoring technical teams and driving high standards of delivery, operational readiness, and continuous improvement. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 In return, you will have the opportunity to lead enterprise-scale AI and digital transformation initiatives within a progressive and innovation-focused environment. You will play a key role in shaping technology strategy, influencing architectural direction, and delivering solutions that create measurable business impact. 
 You'll benefit from working alongside experienced professionals, exposure to emerging technologies, and the ability to make a lasting contribution to the organisation's future digital capabilities. 
  What you need to do now     
 If you're interested in this role, click  'apply now'  to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.  Please  click here  to apply.
